title: .test-status.json
description: Tracks per-test expected states for tdd-ratchet. Committed to the repo.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor support.

baseline.description: Immutable adoption baseline: the commit at which this project began enforcing the ratchet. Set once, then never changed.

tests.description: Map of test names to their expected state. Keys are full nextest names (e.g. 'crate::binary$test_name').

additionalProperties.description: Expected test state. 'pending' = test is expected to fail (not yet implemented). 'passing' = test is expected to pass.

checks.description: Non-test checks (e.g. clippy/fmt) tracked alongside tests. Carried verbatim; not interpreted by tdd-ratchet.

renames.description: Temporary rename bridge mapping new test names to their previous committed names.

removals.description: Transient list of tracked test names to retire on this run only.
